subject.title: msteams: support Copilot-only streaming without enabling Teams DM streaming

question: Should the Microsoft Teams plugin add a supported Copilot-vs-Teams streaming config surface, and which inbound activity metadata is reliable enough to identify Copilot custom-engine conversations?
rationale: Automation can prove the current global-only limitation, but the permanent config key and Copilot detector depend on maintainer product/API judgment and live Microsoft activity evidence.

options.title: Approve detector plus by-surface config
options.body: Add a plugin-owned Copilot detector from redacted live activity metadata and expose an explicit per-surface streaming config with global fallback.

options.title: Approve a targeted Copilot-only key
options.body: Add a narrower `copilotStreaming` style config if maintainers want less schema surface and do not need a general surface map yet.

options.title: Decline per-surface streaming for now
options.body: Keep the current global `channels.msteams.streaming` behavior and document that operators must choose between all personal-scope streaming or no Teams native streaming.

recommendation.title: Approve detector plus by-surface config
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-owned Copilot detector from redacted live activity metadata and expose an explicit per-surface streaming config with global fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux has recent adjacent Teams config work and owns the open Microsoft tracker that already includes this issue.
